questions.prompt: Как описать действующую ежедневную процедуру мытья окон?

choices.text: The windows are cleaned every day.
The windows were cleaned every day.
The windows have been cleaned every day.
The windows had been cleaned every day.

questions.explanation: Текущая регулярная процедура выражается Present Simple passive: *are cleaned every day*.

questions.prompt: Как описать обычную текущую процедуру мытья машины?

choices.text: The car is usually washed.
The car was usually washed tomorrow.
The car has usually washing.
The car usually wash.

questions.explanation: Наречие частотности ставится после *be*: *The car is usually washed*.

questions.prompt: Как сказать, что торт испекли вчера?

choices.text: The cake is baked yesterday.
The cake was baked yesterday.
The cake has been baked yesterday.
The cake had been baked yesterday.

questions.explanation: Завершённый период *yesterday* сочетается с Past Simple passive: *was baked*.

questions.prompt: Как сказать, что проект завершили на прошлой неделе?

choices.text: The project is completed last week.
The project was completed last week.
The project has been completed last week.
The project had been completed last week.

questions.explanation: Завершённый период *last week* сочетается с Past Simple passive: *was completed*.

questions.prompt: Отчёт уже написан, и результат важен сейчас. Как это выразить?

choices.text: The report is written yesterday.
The report was written tomorrow.
The report has already been written.
The report had written already.

questions.explanation: Для результата к настоящему моменту используется Present Perfect passive: *has already been written*.

questions.prompt: Письмо всё ещё не отправлено. Как выразить это с *yet*?

choices.text: The email is not send yet.
The email was not sending yet.
The email has not been sent yet.
The email had not sent yet.

questions.explanation: В отрицательном Present Perfect passive *yet* обычно ставится в конце: *has not been sent yet*.

questions.prompt: Дом только что убрали, и результат виден сейчас. Как это выразить?

choices.text: The house is been just cleaned.
The house was just been cleaned.
The house has just been cleaned.
The house had just cleaned.

questions.explanation: В Present Perfect passive *just* ставится после *has*: *has just been cleaned*.

questions.explanation: В заданном контексте актуального результата используется Present Perfect passive: *has been reviewed recently*.
